backend/main.mo: Main Internet Computer canister actor implementing storage, authorization, user profiles, form submissions, timers, and passcode-gated Market Intelligence with technical indicators, signals, and content stores. Integrates access control, blob storage, HTTP outcalls, and defines core business types and state.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a no-op migration module that returns state unchanged, used as the canister migration hook.
feature_evidence.json: Structured report documenting implemented product features, affected frontend files, dependencies, test requirements, and confidence levels for navigation, Market Intel gating, theming, and UI changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten high-level summaries of frontend pages, components, hooks, and styles describing the unified Market Intel experience and Interlink-ID design system.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS layer defining the Interlink-ID design system with light/dark CSS variables, color tokens, typography, chart colors, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and sets basic metadata for the RBS Official V2.5 site.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application configuring TanStack Router routes for all pages, React Query client, theme provider, and shared layout with footer, bottom navigation, and toaster.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Scrollable bottom navigation bar with emoji-labeled route buttons, active-state highlighting, and client-side navigation via TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Stylized site footer with branding, Telegram and WhatsApp links, gradient accents, and attribution rendered in the Interlink-ID theme.
frontend/src/components/FormsSection.tsx: Empty or placeholder file intended for a forms-related UI component.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Empty or placeholder file intended for the site header/navigation component.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Empty or placeholder file intended for the homepage hero section component.
frontend/src/components/OracleSection.ts: Empty or placeholder file intended for the oracle or AI intelligence display section.
frontend/src/components/WhitepaperSectio: Empty or placeholder file intended for a reusable whitepaper content section.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Defines a React hook that creates and caches a backend actor using React Query, handling authenticated vs anonymous identities. It reinitializes the actor when identity changes and invalidates/refetches dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing login, logout, identity persistence, and login status via DFINITY AuthClient. Exposes a hook for accessing identity state and authentication actions throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for submitting forms, fetching submissions, managing market intelligence access, and checking permissions via the backend actor. Also includes utilities for real-time market data fetching from external APIs.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme variables, typography, colors, animations, and base styles. Establishes the app’s visual design with gradients, gold accents, and custom utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers. Imports global styles and mounts the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders a static About page describing the RBS project’s mission, values, and highlights using styled components and icons. Focuses on branding, security, decentralization, and tokenomics.
frontend/src/pages/AcquisitionPage.tsx: Implements presale and airdrop acquisition forms with countdown timers, progress indicators, and validation. Submits data via backend mutations and integrates user feedback with toasts and WhatsApp redirection.
frontend/src/pages/AdvancedAnalyticsPage: Implements an advanced portfolio analytics page showing portfolio value, performance changes, risk metrics, and correlation data using charts, progress bars, and tabs with static mock data.
frontend/src/pages/AISentimentPage.tsx: Currently an empty page file with no implementation or exports.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityGovernancePa: Renders a marketing-style overview of the community governance system, explaining proposals, voting power, and participation using static content and icon-based cards.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityHighlightsPa: Displays community achievements, featured members, initiatives, and high-level statistics using predefined data arrays and visually rich sections.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityVotingPage.t: Simple placeholder page indicating that the community voting platform is under development and coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides a contact form that opens the user's email client via a mailto link and lists direct contact channels like Telegram and WhatsApp with basic validation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperBlogPage.tsx: Empty or unimplemented developer blog page with no content defined.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperToolsPage.ts: Empty or unimplemented developer tools page with no content defined.
frontend/src/pages/EcosystemGrowthPage.t: Presents ecosystem growth strategy content, highlighting community building, partnerships, integrations, and growth initiatives through static sections and icon cards.
frontend/src/pages/FAQPage.tsx: Renders an FAQ page with collapsible question/answer sections driven by local state. Contains static FAQ data about the RBS project, tokenomics, governance, roadmap, and security.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Implements the landing/home page with a dynamic greeting and animated, simulated live metrics. Showcases branding, slogans, visuals, and key protocol statistics using timed state updates.
frontend/src/pages/InsightsPage.tsx: Displays curated market, economic, governance, and technical insights using static datasets. Uses cards, icons, and progress bars to present trends and metrics related to crypto and RBS positioning.
frontend/src/pages/LivePricePage.tsx: Provides a live-updating price dashboard for multiple crypto assets with simulated real-time changes. Periodically mutates price and 24h change data and renders them in animated cards.
frontend/src/pages/MarketIntelPage.tsx: A complex, access-controlled market intelligence interface supporting crypto and forex assets, timeframes, and trading modes. Integrates multiple hooks for fetching signals, managing permissions, and displaying indicators, alerts, dialogs, and tabs.
frontend/src/pages/PartnersPage.tsx: File exists but contains no implementation or content.
frontend/src/pages/RoadmapPage.tsx: Defines a multi-year development roadmap (2026–2030) with phases, milestones, status, and icons, rendered as a visually rich timeline-style page.
frontend/src/pages/SecurityTransparencyP: Presents security measures, transparency metrics, and risk management information using structured data arrays and styled sections for institutional trust.
frontend/src/pages/TestimonialsPage.tsx: Displays community testimonials and platform statistics using a carousel and stat cards to highlight social proof and adoption metrics.
frontend/src/pages/TokenomicsPage.tsx: Visualizes token distribution and economic model with an interactive pie chart, total supply details, and allocation breakdown.
frontend/src/pages/WhitepaperPage.tsx: Implements a scrollable whitepaper with chapter navigation, intersection-based active section tracking, and structured technical content sections.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions to read URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, persist them in sessionStorage, and retrieve or clear them across navigation. Includes helpers to prioritize URL values over session storage and safely manage sensitive parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode behavior, content scanning paths, container defaults, and an extended theme with custom colors, shadows, radii, and animations. Integrates typography, container queries, and animation plugins for a design-system-driven UI.
project_state.json: Machine-readable snapshot of the project’s current vision, versioning, and implemented features, outlining a shift toward a professional multi-page crypto platform. Documents existing capabilities such as Internet Identity auth, RBAC, gated analytics, real-time market data, and trading signal generation.
